test_nll_loss: test that label smoothed cross entropy criterion reports the same nll_loss as standard cross entropy
test_padding: test that label smoothed cross entropy loss is correct when batch items have padding
test_reduction: test that reduced loss equals the sum of unreduced per-sample losses
test_zero_eps: test that label smoothed cross entropy with zero smoothing equals standard cross entropy loss
run_test_label_smoothing: run the unittest suite for fairseq label smoothed cross entropy criterion
